You can see it in action on my twitter: https://twitter.com/monoxane and its all available on my github: https://github.com/monoxane/docker-speedtweet.

It runs with both Docker (probs you're best option) or with pure python, those running python on Windows may have to hardcode the variables usually set with export because I don't know if that works on Windows
